svg.text: Implementation audit of all system capabilities: Implemented vs Partial vs Mock vs Missing
Regex rules match timetable, mess menu, holidays without LLM overhead. Sub-millisecond execution.
Groq LPU (Qwen 27B) maps natural language queries to ToolCalls. 24h LRU router cache. Gemini Flash fallback.
Cosine similarity (>= 0.45) on pgvector(768) + tsvector English FTS combined via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60).
POST /v1/chat/stream chunks pre-computed answer into 48-char SSE delta slices at 10ms intervals.
Stored in Python dict (_conversations, _messages) in process RAM. Lost on container restart.
Legacy /api/chat writes to query_logs table; active /v1/chat endpoint DOES NOT insert into query_logs.
Strict binary header verification (PDF, XLSX, DOCX, JPEG/PNG). Never trusts client-reported MIME or filename.
Gemini 3 Flash Vision converts document pages to structured JSON. Groq document parser fallback.
Validates ISO days (1-7), time sequence (end > start), meal categories, confidence flags.
Admin inspects extracted JSON preview, corrects cell values, retries failed jobs via PATCH/POST.
Commits records under version N+1, increments data_versions.rev, evicts (scope, rev) cache.
boto3 S3 client falls back to local disk (./uploads/) on Render container because S3 credentials are mock.
Cached domain slots filtered by branch, year, section. Legend maps course codes to faculty names.
Calculates next lecture based on current Asia/Kolkata weekday and time against timetable_slots.
GET /v1/meals computes pairs of menu items fitting under student budget limit with macros.
Trigram search on faculty name and subjects. Displays room/cabin, office hours, and email.
Combines events table with holidays table. Auto-classifies CIE/SEE exam deadlines.
Google Calendar & Gmail buttons simulate OAuth connect/sync and return static mock responses.
14 FastMCP tools exposed via streamable HTTP. 12 active, 2 stubs (detect_conflicts, search_emails). NO AUTH.
Verified against repository source @ commit 4f2ced5 · generated 2026-11-05 · Represents implemented code only; unverifiable items are explicitly labelled.
